Volunteering at ILF is more than just being a part of India’s most vibrant literature festival. From pre-event duties and training to being part of Central India’s largest literature festival, every step is a learning experience. Volunteers give their time, energy, and enthusiasm, while creating memories that stay with them. It is a journey where we learn, grow, connect with people, and experience the world of literature from a different perspective. For us, volunteering at ILF is not just about contributing~it is about growing with the festival and becoming a part of its journey.

Interning at ILF is an experience where passion meets purpose. It is not just about being part of a literary festival, but about learning, contributing, and growing along the way. From communication and coordination to teamwork and responsibility, every task puts practical skills to the test. It demands dedication, respect for the work, and a willingness to learn from every experience. Above all, it is a celebration of the love for literature, people, ideas, and the conversations that bring them together.

The Festival Stall Arena at ILF is a vibrant space where creativity, art, and entrepreneurship come together. It offers artists, creators, publishers, and independent brands an opportunity to showcase their work and connect with a diverse audience. More than just a marketplace, it is a platform to present unique ideas, artistic contributions, and creative expressions as part of India’s vibrant literary celebration. Booking a stall at ILF means becoming a part of an engaging community where creativity meets literature, conversation, and culture.
